claims.summary: The construction -(으)ㄹ 정도로 expresses a degree or level, allowing the preceding clause to serve as a reference for measuring the intensity of the main situation.
The construction is formed with a base verbal or descriptive word, followed by -(으)ㄹ, 정도, and the particle -로, with variations depending on consonant or vowel preceding the construction.
The construction can be used with both positive and negative experiences, as well as real or hyperbolic situations, as long as the second idea can be interpreted as a measure of the degree.
